topics.title: Why the Joker Changes His Scar Story Every Time
topics.hook: The Joker told three different stories about his scars, and all of them were deliberate psychological weapons.
topics.core_thesis: The Joker's contradictory scar origins are psychological mirrors tailored to exploit the specific emotional vulnerabilities of his victims.

topics.title: The Truth Behind the Joker Hospital Detonation
topics.hook: Everyone remembers the Joker hesitating with the detonator.

topics.title: Why Tony's Nanotech Suit Consumes His Clothes
topics.hook: Notice where Tony Stark jacket goes when he suits up?
topics.core_thesis: The nanites consume carbon from his clothing to synthesize armor plating.

topics.title: The Exact Second Cap Became Worthy
topics.hook: Steve Rogers did not become worthy in Endgame.

topics.title: Batman Turns His Childhood Fear Into a Weapon
topics.hook: Bruce Wayne did not choose the bat symbol to strike fear into criminals.
topics.core_thesis: Bruce weaponized his personal childhood phobia.

topics.title: The Secret Meaning of the Ticking Clock on Miller's Planet
topics.hook: Every single tick of Hans Zimmer soundtrack on Millers planet cost Cooper a day of his daughter life.
topics.core_thesis: Hans Zimmer constructed the ticking cue at precisely 1.25 seconds.
